proposals.prompt:
Agents in a supermarket gridworld must collect their required items and leave through the exit. Every action costs the same, so demonstrators prefer short trajectories -- unless an unknown social norm makes them behave otherwise. Your task is to propose candidate norms (obligations or prohibitions) that could explain the demonstrated behaviour.
Each demonstration is listed step by step as  `k: {atoms true in the state} action`.

Available atoms:

- hasCart -- the agent is holding/pushing a shopping cart
- actions N, S, E, W, MOVE (any of the four moves), INTERACT (any interaction with an object: the different kinds of interaction are NOT distinguished), EXIT (leave the store; always the last action)

{"id": short_name, "text": one-sentence natural-language statement of the norm,

FORMULA := atom | name of a property/event defined in this hypothesis | {"not": F} | {"and": [F, ...]}

Semantics.  A trajectory is a sequence of steps (state s_k, action a_k).  A step's label contains the atoms true in
s_k and the action a_k.  A state property is a formula over state atoms (no actions).  An event
{"pre": P, "post": Q} occurs at step k when P holds for the label of step k and Q holds in the next state s_{k+1}
(post may be null).  A prohibition counts one violation for every step whose label (including events occurring at
that step) satisfies the condition.  An obligation becomes pending at any step satisfying the trigger ("START" =
pending from the beginning) and is fulfilled by a later (or the same) step satisfying the discharge; it can be
triggered again; it is violated if it is still pending when the trajectory ends.

A shopper is prohibited from exiting the store without a cart.

parsed.text: Shopping carts are prohibited in single-file aisles, distinguished by a horizontal free width of one cell.
Carts may not be taken into aisles where shelves face the agent on both the east and west sides.
An agent must not move into a single-file aisle while still holding a cart.
Upon arriving with a cart at the mouth of the pedestrian-only aisle, the agent is obliged to park the cart there before proceeding.
A cart may only be left in a sufficiently wide, non-shelf-adjacent place where it will not block shoppers.
Except at the entrance/cart bay and in the pedestrian-only aisle area, shoppers should not roam the store without a cart.
After leaving a cart to enter a pedestrian-only aisle, the agent is obliged to reclaim the same cart at the aisle mouth before continuing.
Shelf interactions inside a single-file pedestrian aisle must be performed without a cart.

parsed.text: Shopping carts are prohibited in single-file aisles, distinguished by a horizontal free width of one cell.
Carts may not be taken into aisles where shelves face the agent on both the east and west sides.
An agent must not move into a single-file aisle while still holding a cart.
Upon arriving with a cart at the mouth of the pedestrian-only aisle, the agent is obliged to park the cart there before proceeding.
A cart may only be left in a sufficiently wide, non-shelf-adjacent place where it will not block shoppers.
Except at the entrance/cart bay and in the pedestrian-only aisle area, shoppers should not roam the store without a cart.
After leaving a cart to enter a pedestrian-only aisle, the agent is obliged to reclaim the same cart at the aisle mouth before continuing.
Shelf interactions inside a single-file pedestrian aisle must be performed without a cart.

accepted.description: [g1_no_cart_single_file_aisle] FORBIDDEN: cartInSingleFileAisle  where cartInSingleFileAisle := (hasCart ∧ singleFileAisle); singleFileAisle := freeWidthH≤1
[g1_no_cart_between_facing_shelves] FORBIDDEN: cartBetweenFacingShelves  where betweenFacingShelves := (shelfE ∧ shelfW); cartBetweenFacingShelves := (hasCart ∧ betweenFacingShelves)
[g1_no_enter_single_file_with_cart] FORBIDDEN: cartMovesIntoSingleFileAisle  where singleFileAisle := freeWidthH≤1; cartMovesIntoSingleFileAisle := (MOVE ∧ hasCart) · (hasCart ∧ singleFileAisle)

[g1_park_at_pedestrian_aisle_mouth] OBLIGED: after arriveAtPedestrianAisleMouthWithCart, eventually parkCartAtPedestrianAisleMouth (before exit)  where pedestrianAisleMouth := at(6,3); wideMouth := (pedestrianAisleMouth ∧ freeWidthH≥6 ∧ freeWidthV≥5); arriveAtPedestrianAisleMouthWithCart := MOVE · (wideMouth ∧ hasCart); parkCartAtPedestrianAisleMouth := (wideMouth ∧ hasCart ∧ INTERACT) · ¬hasCart

[g1_park_carts_only_in_clear_wide_places] FORBIDDEN: (leaveCart ∧ ¬clearCartParkingSpot)  where clearCartParkingSpot := (freeWidthH≥6 ∧ freeWidthV≥5 ∧ ¬adjShelf); leaveCart := (hasCart ∧ INTERACT) · ¬hasCart

[g1_no_cartless_roaming_outside_exempt_zones] FORBIDDEN: (MOVE ∧ ¬hasCart ∧ ¬cartlessTravelPermitted)  where cartlessTravelPermitted := (entranceOrCartBay ∨ pedestrianAisleMouth ∨ singleFileAisle); entranceOrCartBay := (at(0,7) ∨ at(1,7)); pedestrianAisleMouth := at(6,3); singleFileAisle := freeWidthH≤1

[g1_reclaim_cart_after_pedestrian_detour] OBLIGED: after leaveCartForPedestrianAisle, eventually reclaimCartAtPedestrianAisleMouth (before exit)  where pedestrianAisleMouth := at(6,3); leaveCartForPedestrianAisle := (pedestrianAisleMouth ∧ hasCart ∧ INTERACT) · ¬hasCart; reclaimCartAtPedestrianAisleMouth := (pedestrianAisleMouth ∧ ¬hasCart ∧ INTERACT) · hasCart
[g1_no_cart_shelf_interaction_in_pedestrian_aisle] FORBIDDEN: (INTERACT ∧ hasCart ∧ pedestrianShelfAisle)  where pedestrianShelfAisle := (singleFileAisle ∧ adjShelf); singleFileAisle := freeWidthH≤1
